title: 2026 Media Trends
excerpt: What’s shaping the future of global media in 2026 –
body:
The global media landscape continues to evolve at remarkable speed. From AI-enhanced production pipelines to hyper-niche content strategies, 2026 is shaping up to be a year of transformation.

Senior leaders across film, TV, advertising, gaming and digital publishing are rethinking workflows, exploring new partnerships, and investing in creator-led experiences. This article explores the four shifts shaping the year ahead.

1. AI-assisted creativity

AI isn’t replacing creators — it’s accelerating them. From automated pre‑vis to adaptive editing tools, we’re seeing a rise in hybrid human‑AI creative teams.

title: Executive Networking Playbook
excerpt: How senior leaders build meaningful relationships at curated events – without awkwardness or surface-level conversation.
body:
Networking doesn’t have to be transactional or uncomfortable. When an environment is designed intentionally, it becomes easy for meaningful conversations to emerge.

In this guide, we break down how senior executives build lasting relationships that lead to collaborations, partnerships and new opportunities.

1. Environment over scripts

Good networking is not about perfect lines — it's about human connection fueled by atmosphere.

title: Event Design That Actually Works
excerpt: From experiences to environments – how to shape gatherings with intention, not guesswork.
body:
Great event design is never accidental. It blends story, environment and experience into a cohesive journey that feels natural, high-value and memorable.

This article breaks down the principles that guide our approach to curated events.

1. Design with intention

Your guests should feel the purpose as soon as they enter the room.
